meta.title: How it works · AIBA
meta.desc: 5 steps, zero manual intervention: client contacts the bot, picks a slot, pays deposit, gets a reminder and confirms at the appointment.

howItWorks.title: From first question to payment. Hands-off.
howItWorks.subtitle: A fully automated 5-step flow. The AI manages, charges and verifies. You just do your work.
howItWorks.ctaTitle: Ready to stop managing your schedule by hand?
howItWorks.ctaSubtitle: Set up your bot in 5 minutes. 14 days free on any plan.

s1.title: 1. The client contacts the bot
s1.desc: Share your unique WhatsApp or Telegram link (@My_AI_Booking_Assistant_Bot). The bot greets, presents your services with prices and answers questions 24/7 with Claude AI.
s1.example: Client: «Hi, I'd like to book a massage session» → Bot: «Sure! Available: Relaxing massage 60min · €45, Sports massage 60min · €55. Which one fits?»

s2.title: 2. Picks date, time and pays deposit
s2.desc: The bot shows real-time availability from your schedule. When the client picks, a secure deposit link is automatically generated (20-50% of the service, your choice).
s2.example: Bot: «Perfect. Free slots on Thursday: 10:00, 12:30, 17:00. Pay €15 deposit to confirm → https://pay.aib.app/xyz»

s3.title: 3. Reminder with verification code
s3.desc: 1 hour before the appointment, the bot sends an automatic reminder with a 6-digit code. The client has 30 minutes to confirm; if they don't respond, the slot is released.
s3.example: Bot: «⏰ Reminder: relaxing massage today at 17:00. Your code: 384762. Reply YES to confirm.»

s4.title: 4. Automatic final payment at the appointment
s4.desc: When the client arrives, they say or type their code on your dashboard. The system automatically charges the remaining amount with the saved method. No till, no cash, no friction.
s4.example: You: code 384762 → ✅ Charged €30 (rest of service) to María González · Receipt sent by email

s5.title: 5. Mutual rating and community protection
s5.desc: After the appointment, both sides rate each other (1-5 stars). Clients with a reliable history get priority; repeat no-shows are discreetly flagged in the community database to protect other professionals.
s5.example: You rate: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ «Punctual and respectful» → Client rates: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ «Excellent service»

meta.title: FAQ · AIBA
meta.desc: Everything you need to know about AIBA.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitleStart: The questions we get most often. If yours isn't here, email us at
faq.ctaSubtitle: Email us and we reply within 24 business hours.

items.q1: Do I need to know how to program or have technical knowledge?
items.a1: Not at all. You set up your schedule and services in 5 minutes from the web dashboard. The bot chats with your clients on WhatsApp or Telegram without you writing a single line of code. If you can use Instagram, you can use AIBA.
items.q2: How does my client learn about the bot?
items.a2: When you sign up we generate your unique WhatsApp Business link and a Telegram link (@My_AI_Booking_Assistant_Bot with your ID). Share it in your Instagram bio, TikTok, business card, or wherever. Anyone who clicks starts talking to YOUR personalized bot.
items.q3: What happens if a client doesn't show up (no-show)?
items.a3: The deposit is not refunded — it stays as compensation for the blocked slot. Also, the client receives an automatic negative rating, which reduces their credibility for future bookings with other professionals in the network.
items.q4: How long in advance can a client cancel without losing the deposit?
items.a4: You decide when configuring your account. Default: if they cancel more than 1 hour in advance, full refund. Less than 1 hour, they lose the deposit. You can adjust the window to 24h, 48h, or whatever makes sense in your sector.
items.q5: Are my data and my clients' data secure?
items.a5: Yes. We encrypt all data in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). Our servers are in the European Union, we fully comply with GDPR. We never sell or share data with third parties. You can export or delete all your information anytime.
items.q6: Can I manage multiple services with different prices?
items.a6: Yes, plus extras. You can create as many services as you want (or up to 100/month on Basic), with independent prices, durations and deposits. You can also add optional extras.
items.q7: How is the community of professionals protected?
items.a7: There's a private and optional collaborative verification system. When a client no-shows or misbehaves, it's recorded in your history and, with your consent, in an anonymous database that other verified professionals can query.
items.q8: Is there a minimum term or can I cancel anytime?
items.a8: No minimum term. No hidden clauses. Cancel from the dashboard with one click and your account stays active until the end of the paid billing cycle. Your data remains exportable for 30 days before being permanently deleted.

meta.title: About · AIBA
meta.desc: Born in Barcelona in 2026 to remove the wasted time managing schedules. Privacy, community and simplicity are our values.

about.intro: AIBA is an independent Spanish project, created in Barcelona in 2026 by and for self-employed professionals who were losing hours a day answering WhatsApp, jotting appointments on paper and chasing payments.
about.mission: To completely eliminate the wasted time managing schedules, so independent professionals can dedicate every minute to what truly matters: their work, their clients and their life outside the business.
about.origin1: It all started watching friends — masseuses, coaches, photographers, personal trainers — lose hours each week to repetitive tasks: replying «do you have a slot on Thursday?», reminding people via WhatsApp «don't forget tomorrow», chasing payments, dealing with last-minute cancellations.
about.origin2: Tools existed, yes. But none were built for solo professionals, nor did they respect the different trades or the privacy of clients. That's how AIBA was born: a real AI bot, made in Spain, focused on discretion and respect.
about.valuesTitle: Three things we won't compromise on.
about.v1Desc: EU servers, end-to-end encryption, full GDPR compliance. Your data and your clients' data are never sold or shared. Period.
about.v2Desc: We believe independent professionals take better care of themselves when they work as a network. Our collaborative verification system is born from that idea.
about.v3Desc: We don't add features just because they look nice in marketing. Every button, message and notification has a clear purpose: save you time on scheduling.
about.ctaSubtitle: If our philosophy resonates, try the tool for 14 days. No card, no commitment.
